title: Cleanup After Unfinished Test
content: It's important to ensure that any resources or processes left open or running unintentionally are addressed after completing a test. This includes stopping any background processes, releasing locks, and cleaning up temporary files or log entries that may have been created during the test. Let's document the steps to properly clean up after an unfinished test.
